# Mille-neuf-cent-quatre-vingt-dix-neuf
A game to improve speed at reading french numbers. Choose a number range, then click on "Lancer". You will be given a number as text, and you must write it as digits as quickly as you can. Your time be recorded and your results plotted on a graph.
